title: Zobellella sp. CGMCC 1.18722 Genome sequencing and assembly
description: The project aims to sequence and analyse Zobellella sp. CGMCC 1.18722. Assembly sequence was gained by de novo methods, subsequently regarding annotation information was produced by our genomic analysis pipeline. Further study will be carried out with these data.
center: The Institute of Microbiology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
samples: Microbe sample from Zobellella sp. CGMCC 1.18722
